# Synthetic adapter fixtures

These HTML pages exercise public-site extraction shapes using invented product names, identifiers, and monetary examples. They are **test inputs**, not collected observations or current quotes. Site hostnames and route patterns are retained where adapter routing depends on them; they do not establish that the example values were observed there.

Do not copy live HTML, vehicle registration numbers, contact details, browser profiles, or research results into this directory. When a site layout changes, rebuild a small fixture with invented values and update assertions while preserving the relevant DOM structure, visible/hidden states, price conditions, and coverage counts.
